sentence: This project builds crystal films made of twisted fibers whose effect on circularly polarized light can be tuned with light or heat.
This project tries to build very small transistors from two-dimensional semiconductors and find out how far they can shrink.
This project measures water and nutrients in streams draining urban and suburban watersheds to find out how climate and human efforts affect them.
This project builds body-worn sensors that estimate how a person's arms move, to help monitor recovery from strokes.
This project holds a meeting about how centromeres work and how they help chromosomes separate.
This project builds course materials and a virtual laboratory that teach how to secure and safeguard intelligent agents against digital threats.
This project tries to find out how microRNAs, small RNA molecules, control gene expression by using genome editing, live-cell imaging and mathematical models.
This project tries to help probiotic yeast stay in the gut longer by making it attach to and eat the mucus lining the intestines.
This project studies how a plant disease-causing bacterium carried by beetles changes over time and spreads, and whether bacteriophages could help manage it.
This project studies how genes that build fins and limbs help create unusual body structures in fish such as ghost sharks, sculpins and catfish.
This project builds layered materials by joining thin molecular crystals with two-dimensional semiconductors to control how they give off light.
This project develops a way to use a virus to carry gene editing materials into arthropods so that their offspring are genetically modified.
This project develops an ear tube made from natural materials that keeps the middle ear ventilated and can be removed without surgery.
This project measures carbon isotopes in ocean water samples collected on ship cruises to learn how the ocean takes up and moves carbon.
This project studies how attackers could learn secrets from power consumption and communication links in computers made of many linked quantum processors, and builds defenses.
This project builds tools that help communities lower wildfire risk, plan ahead and recover after fires.
This project studies hormones stored in museum whale baleen to learn how environmental change affects the stress, growth and reproduction of bowhead whales.
This project builds experimental and computer methods to understand how soft materials such as hydrogels crack.
This project develops mathematical tools that separate parts of a signal in space or time and in frequency, especially for signals with multiple dimensions.
